matchedRules.reason: Agent-facing OS Explore retrieval, unified investigation-policy, shadow VOI, and E6 controlled-trial promotion-gate changes must prove hard scope, missing-semantic fallback, honest hypothesis/readiness state, neutral reads, explicit relevance evidence, one shared E4 next-action/edit-readiness control, shadow-only empirical E5 VOI abstention/cost math, fixed-sample paired E6 evidence with exact sign-test and required-node safety gates, hosted embeddings, runtime routing, benchmark metrics, and compact/full output without selecting the historically red package-wide OS suite.

Public MCP call timeout is envelope execution metadata, not selected tool input; changes must prove transport separation, local facade deadline propagation, and syntax without selecting the historically red package-wide OS suite.

Task-scoped verify self-hosting depends on facade cwd routing; changes to the executor or its facade regression must run the exact focused routing contract without falling back to the package-wide OS suite.
Durable task eviction, recovery archives, inactivity GC, supervisor scheduling, and facade recovery must prove reversible cleanup without selecting the unrelated package-wide OS baseline.

Work-session filesystem authority must prove trusted session-root routing, escape resistance, generated tool contracts, and unchanged task-session filesystem behavior without selecting unrelated package-wide OS tests.
